output_list.criticism: The 'distr' function has an overflow of integer variable 'totalDistributed' when the totalRemaining amount is less than the value to distribute. This vulnerability can lead to a loss of funds for the contract owner and users who are trying to distribute tokens.

The 'getTokens' function has an overflow of integer variable 'value' when it decreases the large amount due to 'value = value.div(100000).mul(99999);'. This vulnerability can lead to a loss of funds for the contract owner and users who are trying to get tokens.

The 'transfer' function has an overflow of integer variable 'balances' when the balance of sender is more than the transfer amount due to bad token design. This vulnerability can lead to a loss of funds for the contract owner and users who are trying to transfer tokens.

The 'transferFrom' function has an overflow of integer variable 'balances' when the balance of from is more than the transfer amount due to bad token design. This vulnerability can lead to a loss of funds for the contract owner and users who are trying to transfer tokens.

The 'ERC20' contract interface allows attackers to gain unexpected permissions and access control when conducting real world attacks. This vulnerability can lead to a loss of funds for the contract owner and users who are trying to interact with the contract.
